item.title: Elapsed winners for Caribbean 600
item.description: The 2026 RORC Caribbean 600 got underway from Antigua on February 23 for 56 teams, with the 17th edition sending them on the scenic 600 nm course that threads its way around 11 Caribbean islands. Here are the elapsed time winners: Multihull: Jason Carroll’s MOD70 Argo (USA) completed the course in an elapsed time of 01 Day 12 Hrs 01 Mins and 46 Secs after a race-long battle with Jon Desmond’s MOD70 Final Final – Zoulou that finished just over three minutes behind. - Full report Monohull: Remon V

item.title: Curmudgeon’s Observation
item.description: You know times are tough when a Mormon polygamist has only one wife. Providing “insight” since 1997, the Curmudgeon’s Observation has been a hallmark of the Scuttlebutt Newsletter which delivers a digest of major sailing news, commentary, opinions, features and dock talk…with a North American focus. For newsletter information: https://www.sailingscuttlebutt.com/newsletter-read-or-subscribe

item.title: Eight Bells: Keith Taylor
item.description: Keith Taylor, who lived a life under full sail, died February 25, 2026 in Auckland, New Zealand. He was 87 years old. From a blue model yacht on a Christchurch mantelpiece to the helm of SAIL magazine, the world’s leading sailing publication, Keith’s life was shaped by wind, water, and words. He documented America’s Cups, ocean races, round the world attempts, and the evolution of modern yachting with rare authority and elegance. item.title: Field set for Women’s Championship
item.description: Noroton Yacht Club (Darien, CT) has selected twelve skippers for the 2026 Susan Widmann Sinclair Women’s Championship to be sailed in Sonars May 16-17. Skippers were selected on a resume basis and the list of selectees includes former Sinclair champions and leading woman sailors from across North America and Bermuda. - Full report
